اعتزلتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَلْتُنَّ (iʕtazaltunna) /iʕ.ta.zal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# اُعْتُزِلْتُنَّ (uʕtuziltunna) /uʕ.tu.zil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
